intentAndPurpose.intent: `Field.Root` + **Checkbox** with integrated `Field.Label` / `Field.Description`, optional `infoIconSlot`, `error` / `feedback`, and native `Field.Error` slot — same composition contract as **InputField** (Figma `.DNA/InputField` stack; control DNA from Checkbox). Colour follows `appearance` on the inner Checkbox.

props.name: appearance
props.description: Appearance role — border, hover, and checked fill. `auto` → secondary stack.

props.name: aria-describedby
props.description: For composite fields — links to `Field.Description` etc.

props.name: aria-invalid
props.description: Invalid state for form validation (exposed on the checkbox control).

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible label when there is no visible `label` (or when overriding the visible copy). Maps directly to `aria-label` on the underlying checkbox control. When using `CheckboxField`, the visible `Field.Label` provides association automatically — prefer that over `aria-label`.

props.name: checked
props.description: Whether the checkbox is checked (controlled)

props.name: children
props.description: Multiple standalone **Checkbox** options. When set, `label` / `description` render as the field header above the list; `feedback` and Omit for a single integrated field (label and description beside the control per Figma).

props.name: className
props.description: className property

props.name: data-testid
props.description: Test automation id — forwarded to the checkbox control (`BaseCheckbox.Root`).

props.name: defaultChecked
props.description: Default checked state (uncontrolled)

props.name: description
props.description: Description below the label row.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the checkbox is disabled

props.name: error
props.description: Error message (shorthand for `InputFeedback` variant negative).

props.name: feedback
props.description: Feedback slot — pass `<InputFeedback … />` or use `error` string.

props.name: fullWidth
props.description: Stretch to fill container width.

props.name: groupDefaultValue
props.description: Multi-option default checked values (uncontrolled). Use with `children`.

props.name: groupValue
props.description: Multi-option checked values (controlled). Use with `children`.

props.name: id
props.description: HTML id attribute

props.name: indeterminate
props.description: Whether the checkbox is in indeterminate state

props.name: infoIconSlot
props.description: Trailing control beside the label (e.g. custom info `IconButton`, menu, or `InputFieldDefaultInfo`).

props.name: invalid
props.description: Mark the field invalid for `Field.Root` and error chrome on the checkbox wrapper.

props.name: label
props.description: Label text for the field header (multi-option) or integrated checkbox label (single).

props.name: labelWrapper
props.description: Outer wrapper element. Use `'div'` inside `CheckboxField` (with `Field.Label`) so the visible label is not nested inside a second `<label>`.

props.name: name
props.description: Field name for form submission

props.name: onCheckedChange
props.description: Change handler

props.name: onGroupValueChange
props.description: Multi-option change handler. Use with `children`.

props.name: parent
props.description: Marks this checkbox as the select-all parent of its `CheckboxGroup`. Base UI then DERIVES `checked` / `indeterminate` from the children — do not pass either prop yourself — and toggling it selects or clears the whole group. Requires `allValues` on the surrounding `<CheckboxGroup>`.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Whether the checkbox is read-only (visually distinct from disabled)

props.name: required
props.description: HTML required — form validation when unchecked

props.name: size
props.description: Size preset. Default: 'm'

props.name: style
props.description: style property

props.name: validate
props.description: Custom validation — return message(s) or null.

props.name: validationMode
props.description: Validation mode for `Field.Root`.

props.name: value
props.description: Value used when inside a CheckboxGroup

interactionBehavior.summary: CheckboxField is a Field.Root wrapper, not a control: hover, press, tap-scale, and the informative-blue focus halo all belong to the inner Checkbox. The wrapper's job is hit-target wiring. In single-field mode (no children) the Checkbox is `labelAssociation="field"` + `labelWrapper="div"`, which deliberately drops the native `<label>` wrap; the outer `Field.Label` is a real `<label>` with Base UI `htmlFor`, and a unit test confirms clicking that label text toggles the box. The description is a sibling `Field.Description` (`aria-describedby` only) and is not inside the label, so it does not toggle. Multi-option mode flips each child back to `labelAssociation="native"` so that option's own label/description wrap is the hit target, while the field header is a fieldset legend that does not toggle anything.
hover: CheckboxField.module.css has no `:hover` rule. Hover chrome is the inner Checkbox's: the box interior tints, wrapped in `@media (hover: hover)`.
Unchecked hover fills the box with the parent-surface role's `--{Role}-Hover` (Neutral on a bare page). Checked / indeterminate hover steps fill and border to `--{Role}-Bold-Hover`.
There is no hover styling on the field label or description — `Field.Label` is even `cursor: default`, so it does not look clickable even though it is.
press: The inner Checkbox box scales UP on press (`--Motion-Tap-Scale-Up`, 7%) and tints to `--{Role}-Pressed` (unchecked) or `--{Role}-Bold-Pressed` (checked / indeterminate).
Clicking the field label is a native `<label>` activation, so it produces the same press visuals on the box as clicking the box itself.
focus: Focus lands on the inner `role="checkbox"` control, not on the Field.Label. Clicking the label focuses that control.
The halo is Checkbox's two-layer ring whose OUTER colour is `--Informative-Bold` (falling back to `--Focus-Outline`) — a `negative` checkbox still focuses informative-blue.
`:focus-visible` only; clicking the label with a mouse does not paint the ring.
`readOnly` keeps the control in the tab order and does not suppress `:focus-visible`, so a read-only field still shows the halo.
keyboard: CheckboxField adds no key handlers. Keyboard is the inner Checkbox: `Space` toggles on key-up; `Enter` does NOT toggle — Base UI forwards Enter to the form's default submitter.

In single-field mode the visible `Field.Label` is a genuine `<label>` associated via Base UI `htmlFor` with the checkbox control id, so clicking the label text toggles — covered by a unit test. The description is `aria-describedby` only and is not a hit target.

In multi-option mode the field `Field.Label` lives in a `<legend>` and does not toggle any box. Each child is forced to `labelAssociation="native"`, so that option's own label and description wrap in a real `<label>` and clicking them toggles that option only.
`disabled` sets `aria-disabled` on the control and removes it from the tab order; `readOnly` sets `aria-readonly` and keeps it in the tab order.
selected: Single-field checked / indeterminate / `onCheckedChange` are forwarded to the inner Checkbox. Indeterminate is a controlled prop, not a third click state — a click always resolves to checked or unchecked.

Multi-option selection is a CheckboxGroup: `groupValue` / `groupDefaultValue` / `onGroupValueChange`. Each child still exposes `aria-checked` independently; this is not `aria-pressed` and not a radio-style exclusive group.
Checked fill is Checkbox's: `--{Role}-Bold` box with `--{Role}-Bold-TintedA11y` glyph. `appearance` on the field is forwarded onto every option (`'auto'` resolves to `secondary` inside Checkbox).
disabled: `disabled` is passed to `Field.Root` and the inner Checkbox (or CheckboxGroup + every child), and `data-disabled` on the label stack drops the label/description to `--Text-Low`.
Clicking the field label does not toggle when disabled — covered by a unit test.

The inner Checkbox's `not-allowed` cursor IS observable: the box is `pointer-events: none`, so the pointer falls through to the wrapper, which declares `not-allowed`. In single-field mode that wrapper is a `<div>` (because `labelWrapper="div"`) that still carries the cursor.
`readOnly` is the Checkbox contract (no dim from the `:not([data-readonly])` rule, `cursor: default`, Neutral/High ink) forwarded through; `onCheckedChange` is not wired when `readOnly`.
touch: Hover tints never apply on touch-only devices; the inner Checkbox's pressed tint plus the 7% scale-up are the response to a tap on the box.

In single-field mode the `Field.Label` text extends the hit target across the label row; the description row below it does not. In multi-option mode each option's own native `<label>` (its label + description) is the hit target — the fieldset legend is not.
Nothing pads the row to 44px; the box itself is 16/20/24px at S/M/L.
